name: com.perforce/puppet-enterprise
title: Puppet Enterprise MCP
description: Connects AI tools to Puppet Enterprise for managing and automating your infrastructure.

environmentVariables.name: PE_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: The HTTPS endpoint of your Puppet Enterprise MCP server (e.g. https://<mcp-node-fqdn>/mcp). For more information see https://github.com/puppetlabs/pe_mcp_docker.

environmentVariables.name: PE_CA_CERT
environmentVariables.description: Path to your Puppet Enterprise CA certificate file (e.g., /tmp/pe-ca.pem). For more information see https://github.com/puppetlabs/pe_mcp_docker.

environmentVariables.name: PE_RBAC_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: PE RBAC token for authentication. For more information see https://github.com/puppetlabs/pe_mcp_docker.
